body:
You can view this webinar here

HCP is proud to present a Roundtable Compliance Webinar highlighting Compliance Changes and Updates for 2016. Topics will include discussion on these changes for the following areas of compliance:

  • HIPAA
  • OSHA
  • Corporate Compliance
  • H/R

This roundtable webinar is designed for those who currently manage a compliance program with responsibilities for keeping up to date on compliance policies and procedures for an organization. Whether you are a compliance novice or veteran, you'll want to attend to receive timely and helpful instruction for your program. We will also hold a Q&A session and review our online tools and resources to help manage your compliance program using HCP support.
